Microsoft lists the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml package as affected from 10.0.0 through 10.0.9 and fixed in 10.0.10, together with the .NET 10.0 runtime packs, whose System.Xml is also involved, shipped with .NET 10.0.10 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cvvh-rhrc-wg4q, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/10.0/10.0.10/10.0.10.md). DHI dotnet10-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 10 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 264 packages of the twelve published builds (10.0.2-r0, 10.0.3-r0, 10.0.4-r0, 10.0.5-r0, 10.0.6-r0, 10.0.7-r0, 10.0.8-r0, 10.0.9-r0, 10.0.10-r0, 10.0.13-r0, 10.0.14-r0 and 10.0.15-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. Implementation copies of System.Security.Cryptography.Xml.dll are in the Microsoft.AspNetCore.App shared framework (aspnetcore10-runtime, and the .NET SDK and the ASP.NET Core runtime archive held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap), the SDK's own and F# copies and the ASP.NET Core runtime pack in dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap, and, in dotnet10-runtime-artifacts, the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml nupkg, the ASP.NET Core and WindowsDesktop transport nupkg files and the Arcade SDK and Build.Tasks.Feed build-tool nupkg files. Each copy carries the build's own .NET file version, except the build-tool copies, which can carry an earlier 10.0 servicing version (for example 10.0.10 alongside 10.0.13 in the aarch64 10.0.13-r0 build). The System.Security.Cryptography.Xml nupkg version equals the build version. The first eight builds (10.0.2-r0 to 10.0.9-r0) hold unfixed copies; from 10.0.10-r0 on every implementation copy is 10.0.10 or later. The Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework, which holds System.Xml, is at each build's own .NET version in dotnet10-runtime and in the SDK held by dotnet10-runtime-bootstrap. The remaining copies are reference assemblies with no implementation code. The range ends at 10.0.10-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix.

CVE-2026-47302 (GHSA-cvvh-rhrc-wg4q) is a .NET denial of service in XML processing (System.Security.Cryptography.Xml and System.Xml): XML encryption handling during parsing can cause excessive resource consumption or a crash. Microsoft lists the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml package from 8.0.0 through 8.0.3 as affected and 8.0.4 as fixed, together with the .NET 8.0 runtime packs, including linux-musl-x64 and linux-musl-arm64, from 8.0.0 through 8.0.28, fixed in 8.0.29 (https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-cvvh-rhrc-wg4q, https://github.com/dotnet/announcements/issues/410, https://github.com/dotnet/core/blob/main/release-notes/8.0/8.0.29/8.0.29.md). DHI dotnet8-runtime for Alpine 3.23 builds .NET 8 for Linux from Microsoft's source release, and each build's version is the .NET runtime version it carries. Scanned all 220 packages of the ten published builds (8.0.23-r0, 8.0.24-r0, 8.0.25-r0, 8.0.26-r0, 8.0.27-r0, 8.0.29-r0, 8.0.31-r0, 8.0.32-r0, 8.0.33-r0 and 8.0.34-r0) for x86_64 and aarch64, including the files inside the nupkg and other zip archives they hold. System.Security.Cryptography.Xml implementation code is in the ASP.NET Core shared framework (aspnetcore8-runtime), in the .NET SDK and its shared frameworks held by dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, and in dotnet8-runtime-artifacts, which holds the ASP.NET Core runtime packs, internal transport packages and the System.Security.Cryptography.Xml NuGet package. In every build each of these copies is built from that build's own .NET release: 8.0.23 to 8.0.27, with System.Security.Cryptography.Xml package 8.0.2 or 8.0.3, in the first five builds, and 8.0.29 or later, with package 8.0.4 or later, from 8.0.29-r0 on. dotnet8-runtime-artifacts also holds older System.Security.Cryptography.Xml versions (4.7.1, 6.0.1 and 7.0.1, and copies inside .NET build-tool packages) only as source-build reference assemblies, which carry no implementation code. System.Xml implementation code (System.Private.Xml.dll) is in the Microsoft.NETCore.App shared framework in dotnet8-runtime and, in dotnet8-runtime-bootstrap, in the .NET SDK's shared framework, the Alpine runtime pack and the NativeAOT ILCompiler package; in every build each copy reports that build's own .NET version, 8.0.23 to 8.0.27 in the first five builds and 8.0.29 or later from 8.0.29-r0 on. The range ends at 8.0.29-r0 because it is the first published build with the fix; no 8.0.28 build was published for Alpine 3.23.
